name: system-notification
title: System Notification
description: A frosted notification banner with an app icon, title and message slides in from the right and leaves again.
useWhen: A message, alert or reminder pops over a scene, as a plot point or an overlay on screen footage.
A short notification beat of about five seconds with a clean slide in and out.
avoidWhen: The notification should look like one specific real system: this one is deliberately generic.
Several notifications stack or reply to each other: use a chat flow block.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: App name
variables.description: Small uppercase name at the top.

variables.label: Time label
variables.description: Text at the top right of the banner.

variables.label: Message
variables.description: Text under the title, two lines at most.
variables.default: The launch video looks great. Can we publish it tonight?

variables.label: Icon letters
variables.description: One or two letters in the app icon.

variables.label: Banner colour
variables.description: Base colour of the frosted banner.
